label: b38: IQN risk-neutral beside IQN trained under CVaR 0.25, local DQN plumbing, hist8 at 2M steps, IQN (row A4), the paper's risk-sensitive agent: CVaR 0.25 on the acting policy and the target's argmax during training, scored risk-neutrally, seed 8 of 8
notes: Batch b38: row A4 of the algorithm series, the row the group exists for, on the local plumbing (PER 0.6, fork 4, shield 0.8, target every 8 updates, lr 1e-5, batch 128, the eval-driven epsilon), one wave of two cells x 4 seeds. iqnlocal (b38a-d): IQN, N = N' 8 (the paper's remark that 8 'appears to be sufficient', taken because Dopamine's 64 runs at 14 steps/s on this CPU and 8 at 92), K 32, embedding 64, kappa 1, risk-neutral. iqncvar25 (b38e-h): the same head trained as Dabney et al. 2018 section 4's risk-sensitive agent -- the distortion tau <- 0.25 tau on the acting policy and on the target's argmax (SNEK_DIST_RISK_TRAIN=1), every eval risk-neutral as the paper scores it. Read against b35's local DQN cell (b35e-h: 90% perfect by 0.6-1.6M counted steps, then a 71-88% oscillation, 45 stage-B rows, best 96.6) and against each other. The base is the local plumbing because b35 and b36 showed the papers' recipe (batch 32, 1M uniform replay, replay ratio 0.25, epsilon 0.01 unshielded, no fork) does not reach competence in 10M moves on this game for either DQN or C51 (plans/algoExploration/a-return-tail.md section 6, first bullet; decided with the user 2026-09-17). 2M counted steps = 8M moves (b35's local cell reached 90% by 0.6-1.6M and its plateau is what is read; 3M at IQN's rate is a day an arm); eval every 1,000. Stage-A recent perfect rate, best30 and the drawdown columns carry the reading where stage B is sparse. The CVaR *read* of the neutral checkpoints (tools.closeout --policy-variant cvar:0.25) is a hand pass after the batch closes. Prediction (agent, 2026-09-17): the neutral cell sits with b37's heads; the CVaR-trained cell arrives later (it under-explores the food-seeking moves a neutral policy takes) but holds a steadier plateau with fewer evals below 80 and a higher stage-A share at >=98, which is the tail-risk diagnosis in docs/findings.md showing through. Pinned to the desktop, one wave of eight. CPU cost, measured on the laptop 2026-09-17 at 2,000 steps, one arm at a time (counted steps/s): DQN 484, C51 285, QR-DQN N 32 225, N 64 74, N 200 10; IQN N=N' 64 14, 32 23, 16 52, 8 92 -- the quantile Huber grows with N x N' and IQN's cosine embedding is a Linear per (sample, tau), so the papers' N 200 and 64 are days per arm here.
